newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Merita Q1 profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Merita Q1 profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 431 million markka median forecast for banking group Merita first quarter 1997 profit on ordinary operations after credit losses:
(Profit forecasts by 11 analysts, EPS by 5 analysts).
Merita results are due on May 7 around 0900/0700 GMT. In January-March 1996, Merita posted a 263 million markka profit on ordinary operations.
The median of analysts' forecasts for Merita's full-year earnings was a 1.85 billion markka profit on ordinary operations (mean 1.88 billion) and the range was 1.30-2.49 billion markka.
Merita's full-year 1997 profit on ordinary operations was 1.20 billion markka.

Contributors to the survey were: Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, FSB Securites, FIM Securities, Enskilda Securities, Evli Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
